posts.title: The Studio Murder Mystery (1929) by The Edingtons
posts.description: A.C. and Carmen Edington were an American husband-and-wife writing tandem for the movie studios who, similar to Florence Ryerson and Colin Clements , had a brief stint as detective novelists that produced four novels – published between 1929 and 1934. Their detective novels seem to have enjoyed some success at the time, but faded into obscurity and mostly remained out-of-print for nearly a century
